declarations.name: Theorem X1. Four complementary cores
declarations.scope: For all a,b>=2, deleting T in passport(a^2 1^(2b-2)),(b^2 1^(2a-2)),T leaves exactly two AB components. The bipartite four-cycle core is exactly a matching, an A-star plus isolated A-cycle, a B-star plus isolated B-cycle, or an alternating four-vertex path plus one isolated sheet. AB is a full cycle on each component. Path cyclic orders are determined up to relabeling by independent oriented distances alpha in1..a-1 and beta in1..b-1, with the T anchor still free; every pair occurs.

declarations.name: Lemma X2. Synchronized rotation and opposite-color capture
declarations.scope: For all such tuples, Q1^(2k) followed by relabeling by(AB)^k restores A,B and rotates both T endpoints by(AB)^k. If T=(u,v), B movesu and fixesv, the literal identity Q2^2(A,B,T)=(A,TBT,(u,B^-1u)) holds. It replacesu byv only in the chosen B-cycle, leaving A and the complementary B-cycle literal.

declarations.name: Theorem X3. Uniform normalization of every primitive tuple
declarations.scope: For everya,b>=2, all star cores and all nonzero-phase matching cores braid to a path. The matching color word O B^(b-1) A^(a-1) has opposite-color pairs at every nonzero phase. At a path, two captures through an A-star independently prescribe beta while A and the complementary B-cycle stay literal. Heavy exchange maps(alpha,beta) to(b-beta,a-alpha), permitting independent alpha control. Hence every path normalizes to(1,1) and one T anchor. A,B fix the isolated sheet and are transitive on the rest, so conjugates of T generateS_N. Only aligned matchings remain, and they are the single quadratic lift component.

declarations.scope: For all a,b>=2, m=a+b-1,N2m,W=3*(2-indicator(a=b)),D=(2a-1)(2b-1), exactly two full absolute/literal components exist. Primitive: actualS_N, blocks1,N,deck1,literalWm^2(D-1),absoluteWm(D-1)/2. Quadratic: actualS2 wrK withK=A_m ifa,b odd,elseS_m,blocks1,m,N,deck2,literalWm^2,absoluteWm. Full twists identify all product-centralizer relabelings. Equal profiles and all type placements are included.
